title: APEX Hot Air Balloon Rides

services.name: Balloon Rides Page
services.desc: Apex Balloons is one of the most personal, dynamic, exciting and experienced hot air balloon companies in the country. We have been providing safe, enjoyable hot air balloon flights in various regions of the United States for nearly 25 years. We offer hot air balloon flights in the Phoenix & Scottsdale Arizona area with the same passionate commitment to service that our guests have come to expect. We schedule and fly hot air balloon rides in Arizona seven days a week year-round, with balloon flights launching daily at sunrise, weather permitting. Late afternoon sunset flights are available during the cooler months of mid-October through March. We are not a large hot air balloon company - in

blurb: Phoenix hot air balloon rides have been a favorite attraction in Arizona for many years.

quotes.text: My girlfriends and I escaped the winter blues with a trip to Arizona. The Hot Air Balloon ride was our highlight. You and the crew were very accommodating and generous with your time. We highly recommend this "view from the top" with Apex and for most, a once in a lifetime experience! Our post flight was entertaining as well and a very nice touch. If you are on the fence with this idea, we say "Get in the basket". You won't be disappointed! Thanks again!

I wanted to take a moment to share a few photos and thank you for the beautiful sunrise balloon ride on Monday, March 14th. You may remember we were the crew who assisted in the "egg drop" experiment. Speaking for the group, we really appreciated your service, safety and expertise as a pilot. You certainly made the experience fun and informative. Out of all of our the activities for the week, this was the highlight.

Gaye and I really enjoyed our flight with you yesterday (2/16/12). We have checked off another bucket list item in great fashion. Your knowledge of the area and ballooning, made this the highlight of our visit in Arizona. If you are ever in our neck of the woods, let us know and we can repay the favor and show you our back yard. Best wishes for a great season to you and your colleagues.

I just wanted to thank you for the amazing balloon ride that you took my parents and I on as part of the Cornwall Kinsmen Lift-Off Balloon Festival 2011. We flew with you on the Friday night. The ride was absolutely spectacular, and your piloting skills and expert crew made the ride extremely comfortable. I'm enclosing a couple of pictures from the ride.

My family had the experience of a lifetime thanks to Jon Radowski and Above & Beyond! Jon literally went above and beyond. We topped the clouds and skimmed the treetops, oohing and aahing every minute, and feeling utterly safe in our sturdy basket. The ride was peaceful, joyous and tons of fun. We can’t wait to do it again!

Thanks Jon for a great morning. As you can see I've sent you a few pictures. As Andy wasn't with us, I thought you may like to see a few pictures from your client's perspective. Really wonderful to hear a story about an individual who has a dream and works to see it come true. May your dream always shine clearly for you.
